facts.sourceTitle: Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs — Political system

facts.text: Languages spoken here include French, German, Italian and Romansh.
It is a landlocked country in Western Europe.

culture.text: Swiss handicraft traditions include woodcarving around Brienz and lace and fine linens associated with St. Gallen.

food.name: Cheese fondue
food.text: Bread is dipped on long forks into a shared pot of melted cheese, commonly blending several cheeses.
